text: N246826November 13, 2013CLA-2-62:OT:RR:NC:N3:358CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6206.30.3061Ms. Regina White-SantiagoThe Children’s Place Services Company, LLC500 Plaza DriveSecaucus, NJ  07094         RE:  The tariff classification of girl’s wearing apparel from India.   Dear Ms. White-Santiago:In your letter dated October 14, 2013, you requested a tariff classification ruling.  As requested, the sample will be returned to you.The submitted sample, Style #2015987 and described as a swim cover up is a girl’s blouse. The item is constructed from 100% cotton woven gauze fabric.  The tunic length pullover garment features a round neck-line with V-shaped notch, long sleeves with elasticized cuffs, embroidery around the front notch and a hemmed bottom.   While the article is suitable to wear over swimwear, it will primarily be used as a casual blouse.  It will be imported in girl’s sizes XS - XL.The applicable subheading for Style #2015987 will be 6206.30.3061, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for women’s or girls’ blouses, shirts and shirt-blouses: of cotton:  other: other, other: girls’: other.  The rate of duty will be 15.4 percent ad valorem.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Bruce Kirschner at (646) 733-3048.Sincerely,Gwenn Klein KirschnerActing DirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
subject: The tariff classification of girl’s wearing apparel from India.
